issues.title: Urgent: Water Main Rupture on LB Road
issues.description: Potable water pipeline has ruptured and is gushing water across the street, reducing traffic to single lane.
issues.location_text: Near Adyar Signal, LB Road, Ward 172

timeline.note: Citizen registered civic issue with severity level: CRITICAL.
Auto-routed to Water Supply & Sewerage Board (Category rule matched: Water Supply & Sewerage Board). Target SLA: 3 days.
Dispatched emergency crew to isolate valve and patch trunk pipeline.
Field work marked completed by technician. Submitted to Officer for resolution review. Notes: Excavated pipe joint, welded leak clamp, pressure test nominal at 3.5 bar.
Ground works inspected. Water supply restored and road surface re-graveled.
Citizen verified: "Completely Resolved". Feedback: "Verified on site. Leak has stopped completely and water flow restored.". Complaint officially closed.

verification.comment: Verified on site. Leak has stopped completely and water flow restored.

Field crew barricaded spot and prepared bitumen mix base

timeline.note: Citizen reported hazardous pothole via mobile interface.

Assigned to Field Technician Kumaravel P. for emergency cold-mix patching.
Safety cones placed. Excavated loose debris and started bitumen compacting.
